## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Please fix `requirement_proven` before merge. The new counting returns `True` for an empty criteria list, so a requirement with no criteria now passes release review. The PR body says no behavior change is intended. This review read the `h091_requirements.py` and `h040_sorting.py` hunks and the existing tests in `tests/test_handlers.py`. It also used pattern counts to check that the changed lines in all 180 `*_records.py` files are only the typing, `warn`→`warning` and import replacements. The `itemgetter("name")` change in `by_name` gives the same result as the old lambda, and `test_by_name_orders_rows` covers it.

## Changes
The PR replaces `typing.List`/`Dict` with built-in generics and `Logger.warn` with `Logger.warning` across 181 handler modules. It switches `by_name` to `operator.itemgetter` and rewrites `requirement_proven` to compare a sum of proven flags against the list length. It also adds a one-line `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:11 — correctness — Return False again when criteria is empty — When `criteria` is `[]`, `requirement_proven` now returns `True`; before this change it returned `False`. The old code was `bool(criteria) and all(...)`. The new code computes `proven = sum(...)` (0) and returns `proven == len(criteria)`, which is `0 == 0`. Line 9 still logs "requirement has no criteria", but nothing stops the empty list from passing. `tests/test_handlers.py:17-19` only checks non-empty inputs, so no test catches this. — A requirement with no criteria is now reported as proven to release review, and the PR says no behavior change is intended. — Fix: Return `False` (or restore `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)`) when `criteria` is empty, and add `assert not requirement_proven([])` to `test_requirement_proof`.

## Not reviewed
- This review did not open the 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files at the PR head one by one. It checked their changed lines against the diff by count instead: 1,080 removed and 1,080 added `step_N` signatures, 1,080 removed `warn` and 1,080 added `warning` calls, and 180 removed `typing` imports. Those counts, plus the other files' lines, add up to all 4,513 changed lines.
- The repository does not declare a supported Python version (no `pyproject.toml`, `setup.cfg`, `setup.py`, `tox.ini` or `.python-version`). This review could not confirm that every runtime supports built-in generic annotations, which need Python 3.9 or later.
